title: Dura — Smith's Bible Names Dictionary (Bible Gateway)

verification_log.method: Oppert placed the plain south-east of Babylon near the mound of Dowair/Duair, where a pedestal of a huge statue was found; others proposed a tract a little south of Tekrit on the Tigris ("Dur")

access_notes: 19th-century reference; reports Oppert's proposal without modern verification.
